festival.title: A place for local film
festival.text: An independent film club asks you to sponsor its next program.

sponsor.label: Sponsor the program ($900); build a community partnership

festival_return.title: The club comes back
festival_return.text: Your sponsored club has attracted a regional festival. Choose how to host it.

host.label: Host the festival ($1,200); +18% attendance this month

small.label: Offer a modest reception ($200); +5% attendance this month

midnight_craze.title: The Midnight Picture Club
midnight_craze.text: Local university students petition for late-night cult and horror double features on weekends.

permit.label: Sanction midnight screenings ($350 in late staffing); +12% attendance this month

refuse.label: Keep regular closing hours to protect the venue

heatwave_rush.title: Summer Heatwave
heatwave_rush.text: Sweltering heat blankets the region. Residents seek refuge in air-conditioned public spaces.

crank_ac.label: Overhaul ventilation cooling ($600 power and coolant); +20% attendance surge

standard.label: Maintain standard thermostat settings ($0); +6% natural turnout

civic_premiere.title: Civic Benefit Premiere
civic_premiere.text: The mayor's office proposes co-hosting a charity premiere for the children's hospital fund.

cohost.label: Donate lobby and screening hall ($800); prestige and community goodwill

decline.label: Politely decline due to tight booking commitments

censorship_board.title: The Decency League Inquest
censorship_board.text: A vocal community morality board complains that a scheduled release offends public sensibilities.

defend.label: Defend artistic expression ($300 legal council); earns fierce loyalty among film buffs

cave.label: Agree to voluntary cuts; placates the board but disappoints purists

concession_expo.title: National Concessionaires Expo
concession_expo.text: A trade convention invites your management team to attend workshops on snack margins and display design.

attend.label: Send staff to the trade expo ($750 travel & passes); boost merchandising know-how

skip.label: Keep all staff on the counter floor at home

critic_spotlight.title: Syndicated Column Spotlight
critic_spotlight.text: A distinguished metropolitan arts columnist selects your flagship theater for an architectural tribute.

celebrate.label: Host a press reception with champagne and hors d'oeuvres ($500); +15% attendance

modest.label: Issue a gracious press release ($0); +5% attendance
